Create ONE finished distinct standalone graphic, not a garment mockup. Professional rich crisp detailed illustration with strong silhouette and visual hierarchy. Portrait 2:3 composition. Center entire motif with safe margin, no clipped details. Transparent outside the motif, no rectangular background, no checkerboard, no environment beyond the motif. The design should stand out on both black and white cotton. Print-friendly well defined edges, no faint smoke at the boundary. No text, no lettering, no watermarks, no brand marks, no existing franchise characters.
